findings.description: Independent coefficient check now actually extracts a bivariate polynomial coefficient.
Independent de Sitter radius renamed ell_dS; frozen A,U0 not retuned.
Propagator and prepared density kernel gluing separated; mixed-state regression added. Independently also found by A and B.
Trace distance example restricted to coherent balanced pure state.
Reject relative and dynamic imports/execution in new scientific source.
Threshold/distance now checked from exact threshold, source bands and coupling integral; sign distance conservative.
Generic apparatus noise formula explicitly assumes vacuum product input and common derivative margins on the full connecting slab.
Positive compact test is an existence statement; constraint-image tests may have zero norm.

findings.finding: Unused importlib allowance exceeded the static import-guard description; no actual reviewed science source used it.
findings.fix: Removed importlib from the non-runner import allowlist. The runner separately uses importlib.metadata. Static rules are stated as limited checks, not a general execution sandbox.

findings.finding: Static ground-energy trace needed an explicit finite-block subscript because the convergence proof used a free-tail extension.
findings.fix: Specified Tr_(Pi_K H) and explicitly excluded the infinite free tail. The numerical script already used only finite blocks.

nonblocking_clarifications: CP4_A: T now cross-references U spectral-zero normal limit and keeps the locally covariant physical-phase limit open.
CP5_A: pointwise local Ward identity is distinguished from the exact finite-cutoff total-energy work identity; clarified in next checkpoint.
